text: Stay hungry, stay foolish. 求知若饥，虚心若愚。
author: Steve Jobs

text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it. 预测未来的最好方式就是去创造它。
author: Alan Kay

text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code. 空谈误国，实干兴邦（代码见真章）。
author: Linus Torvalds

text: Done is better than perfect. 先完成，再完美。
author: Sheryl Sandberg

text: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability. 简单是可靠的前提。
author: Edsger W. Dijkstra
